name: io.github.newrelic-experimental/preflight
description: New Relic MCP server for observing AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

packageArguments.name: --stdio
packageArguments.description: Run as an MCP stdio server (required for MCP clients)

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: New Relic ingest license key. Optional: without it Preflight runs local-only with the dashboard at localhost:7777.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: New Relic account id, used for dashboard and alert deployment. Optional.
